agentPage.title: Agents
agentPage.intro: Your organization's agents. Each one specializes in your business, and you can turn it on, pause it and customize it.
agentPage.emptyDescription: Here you will see its conversation, what it has done and what it has pending once it starts working: with its instructions, skills, channels and autonomy.

descriptions.reception: Scheduling: creates, moves and cancels appointments, manages the waiting list and reminders, organizes resources and rooms, and answers the business phone line.
descriptions.customer: Serves your customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, email and the web: answers questions and issues, handles reviews and hands over to a person when needed.
descriptions.sales: Captures and qualifies leads, keeps the CRM, prepares quotes, follows up, wins back customers and runs the campaigns the coach proposes.
descriptions.admin: Invoicing through your own software, collections, expenses, inventory and suppliers, documents and the information your accountant needs.

agentPage.noAgentsDescription: Your agents appear once you belong to an organization: accept the invitation you were sent.

approvalsPage.title: Approvals
approvalsPage.description: What the agent proposes and is waiting for a person. Approving sends the reply or makes the booking; rejecting does nothing.
approvalsPage.empty: When the agent leaves a reply or an appointment as a draft, it will show up here.
approvalsPage.truncated: Showing the {count} oldest. The next ones appear as you decide these.

errors.invalid: The decision could not be read. Please try again.
errors.not_allowed: You cannot decide this approval: it is not from your location, it was already decided or it has expired.

inboxPage.title: Inbox
inboxPage.description: Conversations with your customers in the selected scope: who is handling each one and the latest message. It refreshes on its own.

emptyTitle.human: No conversations handled by the team

empty.open: When a customer writes through a connected channel, the conversation shows up here.
empty.human: When someone on the team takes over a conversation from the agent, it shows up here.

inboxPage.noResults: No conversation in this tab has a customer named like “{search}”.
inboxPage.choose: Choose a conversation to read it.
inboxPage.takeOverDescription: The agent will stop replying to {name} until you hand it back. You will write instead. The change is logged.
inboxPage.composerHint: The agent is handling this conversation. Take over to write yourself: the agent pauses until you hand it back.

errors.invalid: Write a message before sending it.
errors.not_allowed: You can't do this here: the conversation is not in your scope, someone already changed who is handling it, or it is closed.
errors.failed: It didn't work. Please try again.

testChat.title: Try it
testChat.description: Write as if you were a customer. The agent answers with the real model, and you approve what it proposes here or in Approvals.
testChat.realWarning: What you approve here is real: an approved booking takes up the location's calendar. Each message costs one agent turn.
testChat.empty: You have not written to it yet. Try “Do you have a slot on Monday?”.

errors.invalid: Write a message of up to 2000 characters.
errors.not_allowed: You cannot test this agent at this location.
errors.paused: The agent is paused: it cannot be tested.
errors.too_many: You have sent many test messages in the last hour. Please wait a little.
errors.failed: It could not be sent. Please try again.

knowledgePage.title: Knowledge
knowledgePage.description: What your agents know about your business. They answer customers only with what is written here.
knowledgePage.privacy: Write business information (questions and answers, prices, policies), never data about customers or patients: the text is sent to the indexing provider.
knowledgePage.mfaRequired: You need two-step verification to add or change sources.
knowledgePage.empty: Add your frequent questions, prices and policies so the agents can answer with them.
knowledgePage.emptyReadOnly: When an administrator adds frequent questions, prices or policies, they will show up here.
knowledgePage.newDescription: The agents will use it once it is indexed, in a few seconds.
knowledgePage.bodyHelp: Up to 20,000 characters. Separate each topic with a blank line.

statusHelp.pending: It will be indexed in a few seconds. Until then, the agents do not use it.
statusHelp.processing: It is being indexed. The agents will use it in a few seconds.
statusHelp.ready: The agents use it to answer.
statusHelp.error: It could not be indexed, so the agents do not use it. This happens if the indexing provider fails or if your model policy does not allow it (for example, EU only). Change the text to try again.

knowledgePage.deleteDescription: The agents will stop using it. This cannot be undone.

errors.invalid: Check the fields: the title can have up to 200 characters and the text up to 20,000.
errors.not_allowed: You cannot change the knowledge of this organization.
